title: Predicting the Future
question: What was the 'future' electronic development that Leon Bagrit wasn't able to foresee?

meanings.usage: 指根据现有信息推断未来事件
指提前知道或预见将要发生的事

meanings.meaning: 众所周知地；声名狼藉地
meanings.usage: 修饰形容词，强调某事出名（通常指坏的方面）
指大型计算机系统，通常用于企业或政府机构
形容早期、技术不发达的事物
指容易使用和理解的产品或系统
指结合文字、图像、声音等多种媒介的技术
指拒绝接受或不认真考虑某个想法
与of连用，表示具备做某事的能力
主要用于医学领域，指判断疾病
指不再稀奇、变得普通的事物
表示即时发生，没有延迟
形容值得注意或不同寻常的事物
常与of连用，表示免除某人的负担或工作
指涉及电子技术的设备或系统

phrases.usage: 早在...（用于强调时间久远）

examples.en: As long ago as the 1960s, Leon Bagrit predicted these uses.
examples.zh: 早在20世纪60年代，莱昂·巴格瑞特就预测到了这些用途。

examples.en: It pointed the way to the future.
examples.zh: 它指明了未来的方向。

examples.en: Many of their functions have been taken over by small personal computers.
examples.zh: 许多功能已被小型个人电脑所取代。

examples.en: They would be capable of providing information about traffic jams.
examples.zh: 它们将能够提供有关交通拥堵的信息。

phrases.usage: 解除某人的...；使某人从...中解脱

examples.en: They would relieve office workers of dull, repetitive clerical work.
examples.zh: 它们将把办公室工作人员从枯燥重复的文书工作中解放出来。

phrases.usage: 他也无法预见（用于否定句后加强语气）

examples.en: Nor could he have foreseen the development of the Internet.
examples.zh: 他也不可能预见互联网的发展。

examples.en: Computers linked to telephone networks.
examples.zh: 与电话网络相连的计算机。

examples.en: Computers have become more and more powerful.
examples.zh: 计算机变得越来越强大。

phrases.phrase: it is even more remarkable that

examples.en: It is even more remarkable that an Englishman could predict these uses.
examples.zh: 更值得注意的是一个英国人能够预测这些用途。

examples.en: Bagrit dismissed the idea that computers would learn to 'think' for themselves.
examples.zh: 巴格瑞特摒弃了计算机会学会'独立思考'的观念。

sentences.en: Predicting the future is notoriously difficult.
sentences.zh: 预测未来是出了名的困难。

sentences.en: Who could have imagined, in the mid 1970s, for example,
sentences.zh: 举例来说，在20世纪70年代中期，谁能想到，

sentences.en: that by the end of the 20th century, computers would be as common in people's homes as TV sets?
sentences.zh: 到20世纪末，电脑在人们家中会像电视机一样普及？

sentences.en: In the 1970s, computers were common enough,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，电脑已经很常见了，

sentences.en: but only in big business, government departments and large organizations.
sentences.zh: 但只存在于大企业、政府部门和大型机构中。

sentences.en: These were the so-called mainframe machines.
sentences.zh: 这些就是所谓的“大型机”。

sentences.en: Mainframe computers were very large indeed often occupying whole air-conditioned rooms,
sentences.zh: 大型机确实非常大，常常占据整个空调房间，

sentences.en: employing full-time technicians and run on specially-written software.
sentences.zh: 雇用全职技术人员，并运行专门编写的软件。

sentences.en: Though these large machines still exist,
sentences.zh: 尽管这些大型机器仍然存在，

sentences.en: many of their functions have been taken over by small powerful personal computers, commonly known as PCs.
sentences.zh: 但它们的许多功能已被小型、强大的个人电脑（通常称为PC）所取代。

sentences.en: In 1975, a primitive machine called the Altair, was launched in the USA.
sentences.zh: 1975年，一台名为Altair的原始机器在美国问世。

sentences.en: It can properly be described as the first 'home computer' and it pointed the way to the future.
sentences.zh: 它完全可以被称为第一台“家用电脑”，它指明了未来的方向。

sentences.en: This was followed, at the end of the 1970s, by a machine called an Apple.
sentences.zh: 随后，在20世纪70年代末，一台名为Apple的机器问世。

sentences.en: In the early 1980s, the computer giant, IBM produced the world's first Personal Computer.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代初，电脑巨头IBM生产了世界上第一台个人电脑。

sentences.en: This ran on an 'operating system' called DOS,
sentences.zh: 它运行在一个名为DOS的“操作系统”上，

sentences.en: produced by a then small company named Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 由当时一家名为微软的小公司开发。

sentences.en: The IBM Personal Computer was widely copied.
sentences.zh: IBM个人电脑被广泛复制。

sentences.en: From those humble beginnings,
sentences.zh: 从这些不起眼的开端，

sentences.en: we have seen the development of the user-friendly home computers and multimedia machines which are in common use today.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了今天普遍使用的用户友好的家用电脑和多媒体机器的发展。

sentences.en: Considering how recent these developments are, it is even more remarkable that as long ago as the 1960s, an Englishman,
sentences.zh: 考虑到这些发展是如此之新，更令人称奇的是，早在20世纪60年代，一位名叫

sentences.en: Leon Bagrit, was able to predict some of the uses of computers which we know today.
sentences.zh: 莱昂·巴格里特的英国人就能预言我们今天所知道的一些电脑用途。

sentences.en: Bagrit dismissed the idea that computers would learn to 'think' for themselves and would 'rule the world', which people liked to believe in those days.
sentences.zh: 巴格里特驳斥了电脑会学会“独立思考”并“统治世界”的观点，这在当时是人们喜欢相信的。

sentences.en: Bagrit foresaw a time when computers would be small enough to hold in the hand,
sentences.zh: 巴格里特预见到一个时代，那时电脑会小到可以手持，

sentences.en: when they would be capable of providing information about traffic jams and suggesting alternative routes,
sentences.zh: 能够提供交通堵塞信息并建议替代路线，

sentences.en: when they would be used in hospitals to help doctors to diagnose illnesses,
sentences.zh: 在医院里用来帮助医生诊断疾病，

sentences.en: when they would relieve office workers and accountants of dull, repetitive clerical work.
sentences.zh: 解放办公室职员和会计师们枯燥、重复的文书工作。

sentences.en: All these computer uses have become commonplace.
sentences.zh: 所有这些电脑用途都已变得司空见惯。

sentences.en: Of course, Leon Bagrit couldn't possibly have foreseen the development of the Internet,
sentences.zh: 当然，莱昂·巴格里特不可能预见到互联网的发展，

sentences.en: the worldwide system that enables us to communicate instantly with anyone in any part of the world by using computers linked to telephone networks.
sentences.zh: 这个全球性的系统使我们能够通过连接到电话网络的电脑与世界任何地方的任何人即时交流。

sentences.en: Nor could he have foreseen how we could use the Internet to obtain information on every known subject,
sentences.zh: 他也无法预见到我们如何利用互联网获取所有已知主题的信息，

sentences.en: so we can read it on a screen in our homes and even print it as well if we want to.
sentences.zh: 以便我们可以在家中屏幕上阅读，如果需要甚至可以打印出来。

sentences.en: Computers have become smaller and smaller, more and more powerful and cheaper and cheaper.
sentences.zh: 电脑变得越来越小，越来越强大，也越来越便宜。

sentences.en: This is what makes Leon Bagrit's predictions particularly remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这就是莱昂·巴格里特的预测显得格外引人注目的原因。

sentences.en: If he, or someone like him, were alive today, he might be able to tell us what to expect in the next fifty years.
sentences.zh: 如果他，或者像他一样的人，今天还活着，他或许能告诉我们未来五十年会发生什么。

exercises.prompt: “有能力的；能够...的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: capable · /ˈkeɪpəbl/ · adjective · 有能力的；能够...的。与of连用，表示具备做某事的能力

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：非凡的；引人注目的
exercises.explain: remarkable · /rɪˈmɑːkəbl/ · adjective · 非凡的；引人注目的。形容值得注意或不同寻常的事物

exercises.answer: it is even more remarkable that
exercises.explain: it is even more remarkable that：更值得注意的 是...（更值得注意的是一个英国人能够预测这些用途。）

exercises.explain: when they would relieve office workers and accountants of dull, repetitive clerical work. — 解放办公室职员和会计师们枯燥、重复的文书工作。

source.en: when they would relieve office workers and accountants of dull, repetitive clerical work.

exercises.prompt: “情态动词could/might/must + have + 过去分词结构用于表达对过去事件的推测、批评或惊讶” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词（表达对过去的推测或可能性）
让步/原因状语从句的省略
Only + 状语 置于句首的倒装
exercises.explain: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词（表达对过去的推测或可能性）：Subject + could/might/must/would have + past participle：这个结构用于：1) 对过去的推测（could have been, might have been）；2) 虚拟语气中的假设；3) 表达'本可以'但未实现的可能性

source.title: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词（表达对过去的推测或可能性）

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Predicting the future is notoriously difficult.
options: 他们无物可卖，也无需别人的任何东西。
她拿出了各种稀奇古怪的混合物，但没有一样符合哈里的要求。
穿上衣服后，理查兹夫人下了楼。
预测未来是出了名的困难。
exercises.explain: Predicting the future is notoriously difficult. — 预测未来是出了名的困难。

source.en: Predicting the future is notoriously difficult.

grammar.title: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词（表达对过去的推测或可能性）
grammar.definition: 情态动词could/might/must + have + 过去分词结构用于表达对过去事件的推测、批评或惊讶
grammar.usage: 这个结构用于：1) 对过去的推测（could have been, might have been）；2) 虚拟语气中的假设；3) 表达'本可以'但未实现的可能性

examples.en: Who could have imagined, in the mid 1970s, that computers would be common in homes?
examples.zh: 在20世纪70年代中期，有谁能够想象计算机会在家庭中普及？

examples.en: Leon Bagrit couldn't possibly have foreseen the development of the Internet.
examples.zh: 莱昂·巴格瑞特不可能预见互联网的发展。

examples.en: If he were alive today, he might be able to tell us what to expect.
examples.zh: 如果他今天还活着，他也许能告诉我们该期待什么。

grammar.title: nor/neither...nor 的倒装用法
grammar.definition: 当nor或neither...nor连接两个否定成分时，可以使用倒装语序
grammar.structure: Nor/Neither + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + ... .
grammar.usage: 用于否定句后，连接第二个否定成分，强调两者都不。nor could he have foreseen是'他也无法预见'的意思，强调连...也无法做到

examples.en: Nor could he have foreseen the development of the Internet.
examples.zh: 他也不可能预见互联网的发展。

examples.en: Neither does he want to go, nor will he change his mind.
examples.zh: 他既不想去，也不会改变主意。

grammar.title: 过去完成时在间接引语中的使用
grammar.definition: 当主句动词是过去时，间接引语中的动词通常需要使用过去完成时
grammar.structure: 主句动词（过去时）+ that + 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于报道过去某人所说的话或想法，使时间关系更加清晰。Bagrit foresaw a time when computers would be small...中，would表示过去的将来

examples.en: Bagrit dismissed the idea that computers would learn to 'think' for themselves.
examples.zh: 巴格瑞特摒弃了计算机会学会'独立思考'的观念。

examples.en: He predicted that computers would be small enough to hold in the hand.
examples.zh: 他预测计算机会小到可以握在手中。

original.en: Who could have imagined, in the mid 1970s, that by the end of the 20th century, computers would be as common in people's homes as TV sets?
original.zh: 在20世纪70年代中期，有谁能够想象到20世纪末计算机会像电视机一样普及到家庭中？

examples.en: Who could have imagined, in the 1990s, that smartphones would replace cameras?
examples.zh: 在90年代，有谁能够想象智能手机会取代相机？

examples.en: Who could have predicted that AI would develop so rapidly?
examples.zh: 有谁能够预测人工智能会发展得如此迅速？

original.en: Of course, Leon Bagrit couldn't possibly have foreseen the development of the Internet.
original.zh: 当然，莱昂·巴格瑞特不可能预见互联网的发展。

examples.en: The ancient Egyptians couldn't possibly have foreseen modern technology.
examples.zh: 古埃及人不可能预见现代科技。

examples.en: Early scientists couldn't possibly have imagined the internet.
examples.zh: 早期的科学家不可能想象到互联网。

patterns.pattern: It is even more remarkable that...

original.en: Considering how recent these developments are, it is even more remarkable that as long ago as the 1960s, an Englishman was able to predict some of these uses.
original.zh: 考虑到这些发展是多么新近，尤其值得注意的是，早在20世纪60年代，一个英国人就能预测到其中一些用途。

examples.en: It is even more remarkable that he solved the problem in minutes.
examples.zh: 更值得注意的是他在几分钟内就解决了这个问题。

examples.en: It is even more remarkable that she learned three languages in a year.
examples.zh: 更值得注意的是她在一年内学会了三种语言。

patterns.pattern: ...when they would be capable of doing...

original.en: Bagrit foresaw a time when computers would be small enough to hold in the hand, when they would be capable of providing information about traffic jams.
original.zh: 巴格瑞特预见了这样一个时代：计算机会小到可以握在手中，能够提供交通拥堵信息。

examples.en: Scientists foresee a time when robots would be capable of doing all housework.
examples.zh: 科学家预见了机器人能够做所有家务的时代。

examples.en: He imagined a future when people would be capable of traveling to Mars.
examples.zh: 他想象人们能够前往火星的未来。
